remarks:
PRICED TO SELL! 114 Sage Avenue offers a fantastic opportunity to build your dream home or investment property. This residential lot measures 30 feet wide by 145 feet deep, providing plenty of space and flexibility for a variety of build options. 

Situated on a quiet street, the property is surrounded by established homes and is just minutes from Cazenovia Park, Mercy Hospital, local schools, shops, and restaurants. Utilities are available at the street, and the lot is zoned for residential use. 

Whether you're a builder, investor, or future homeowner, this is a rare chance to own land in one of Buffalo’s most desirable neighborhoods. Don’t miss out on this great opportunity in South Buffalo!
